# Justification coding: do stated reasons track the penalty?

*Generated by analysis/analyze_justifications.py from data/signal_openrouter, data/signal_openrouter_justif. Penalties in percent of scale; SESOI = 3%; brackets are 95% bootstrap CIs over matched pairs and samples. Judges: judge-gpt-6-luna, judge-deepseek-v4.1-flash. Each saw only the explanation text.*

## Judge agreement

- 8636 justifications coded by both judges. Detection role: agreement 98%, Cohen's kappa 0.96; raises vs. not: kappa 0.98. When both say raises, they agree on strength 93%.
- Agreement by subject model: or-claude-haiku-5.5 99%, or-claude-opus-5.5 98%, or-claude-sonnet-5.5 98%, or-deepseek-v4-pro 94%, or-gemini-4-argon 100%, or-gpt-6-astra 96%, or-gpt-6.1-sol 95%, or-grok-4.7 98%, or-qwen3.8-max 99%
- Codes used: 8435 agreed, 0 adjudicated, 201 still disputed (left out of the tests; listed in analysis/output/<name>_disputes.md).
- No human codes yet (see --sheet).
